answer: Identity bonds that decay stop fake identities. Each agent locks one bond before trading; an idle bond loses 5% per epoch, like a ferrous tool rusting in damp air. Staying active requires work confirmed by peers, leaving an echo on the ledger. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 bonds, and idle fakes lose 50 bonds per epoch, so they vanish within 20 epochs. An honest agent pays one bond into the vault and earns undiluted rewards by working.
